culprit_citations.quoted_text: Industry | Issuer | Acquisition Date | Investment | % of Net Assets | Par Amount | Maturity Date | Amortized Cost | Fair Value

rationale: FX01 flagged missing principal_amount_usd on supposed non-USD debt principal rows. Raw SOI schedule headers and representative rows show Par Amount, Amortized Cost, and Fair Value are dollar-denominated with dollar signs on the schedule, and targeted source searches for EUR, GBP, CAD, and foreign currency returned no hits. The source therefore does not support a non-USD par requiring FX conversion; the flag appears to come from currency/source classification rather than a data error in the extracted holding.
